answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Each submission hangs on the zenith of a task receipt, and the sonnet is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on time-locked work history, re-queued for a second panel, no identity may audit its own recruit. Reaching the saffron of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
